MCP Tools (planned)

ToolDescription
spec_validateValidate a SPEC.md against the format standard
spec_lintCheck for best practices and common issues
spec_generateGenerate a SPEC.md from a natural language description
spec_test_genGenerate test cases from acceptance criteria
spec_diffCompare two spec versions
spec_searchSearch FleetPrompt registry for similar specs

CLI

specprompt validate SPEC.md
specprompt lint SPEC.md
specprompt test-gen SPEC.md --output tests/
specprompt diff SPEC.md@v1.0 SPEC.md@v2.0
specprompt publish SPEC.md --registry fleetprompt
